subset_derivation_explanation: LLST42 was the legacy 8-shot landscape sequence from early Phase 7C.2 contracts. In Phase 7C.2R4/R4P4, the project captured authentic physical 12-shot portrait sequence P2R16_S23_PORTRAIT_12SHOT_PHYSICAL_01. The frozen geometry P2R16_R4P4R1_BOUNDED_POSE_GEOMETRY.npz strictly contains 12 camera poses. All 12 physical images are used for 4K composition (4096x623, [-26.38 deg, +28.39 deg]). Held-out support images are the 4 source frames containing canonical anchors ROI_01, ROI_02, ROI_06, and ROI_03.
